description: The VpnHood desktop host: the commands that drive a running app over its own API, and the daemon that is that app on a machine with no window. Platform-free - what a service is and where an install keeps things is the platform package's to say (Desktop.Linux, Desktop.Windows)

The VpnHood desktop host on Linux: systemd is the service, /opt is the install, XDG is the cache, and root is who runs the daemon. Everything the commands themselves do is VpnHood.AppUi.Hosting.Desktop

The VpnHood desktop host on Windows: a LocalSystem service is the app, ProgramData is its storage, and the window, the tray and the commands run as whoever is signed in. Everything the commands themselves do is VpnHood.AppUi.Hosting.Desktop
Hosts the VpnHood app under a .NET MAUI UI on Android and Windows, in the app's own process: the platform's start, the Android activity's events, and the app's API for the MAUI pages
